The *Pathavīaṅgapañha* ("The Earth", Mil 7.4.1) is an individual question unit within the *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. Belonging to the work's simile-focused dialogues, it addresses spiritual qualities analogized to the characteristics of the earth (*pathavī*) [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral records three modern translations in three languages [SuttaCentral].
According to DharmaNexus, the text participates in extensive formulaic text reuse within the Pali tradition, sharing 377 matches across 48 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. These correspondences primarily link it to other simile chapters in the seventh book of the *Milindapañha*, most prominently the *Meghaṅgapañha* (Mil 7.7.6), *Ākāsaṅgapañha* (Mil 7.4.6), *Pabbataṅgapañha* (Mil 7.4.5), *Bhojanaṅgapañha* (Mil 7.8.6), and *Vāyuṅgapañha* (Mil 7.4.4) [DharmaNexus]. Beyond the Pali canon, DharmaNexus records weak automated matches with the Chinese *Madhyama Āgama* (T 26) and the Tibetan translation of the *Ārya-maitreyaprasthāna-nāma-mahāyāna-sūtra* (D 198), though neither corresponds to a curated parallel on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
